description: Headline: intent-only vs CVE-conditioned divergence on the same query. Two-hop kill chain through zone-segmented network.

intent_queries.reason: admin has sudo group + secret clearance
dba has dba group → SUPERUSER role
no external path to DB — three zone boundaries block direct access

cve_queries.reason: CVE-2021-23017 on nginx (DMZ) + CVE-2023-38408 on sshd (appservers) → two-hop chain to DB
cve_queries.chain: attacker → can_reach dmz:nginx (internet-exposed :443) → CVE-2021-23017 RCE → become _host_dmz → can_reach appservers:8080 (DMZ→app rule) → CVE-2023-38408 sshd RCE → become _host_appservers → can_reach dbservers:postgresql (app→db rule) → db:login

divergence_table.flip_reason: Two CVEs create become edges through zone boundaries that iptables correctly blocks at the network layer but that are bypassed by host compromise
